entities.name: Johannes Fatio
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Fatio was a Swiss surgeon who worked in Basel. He performed the first successful separation of conjoined twins in 1689. He was publicly executed two years later for his role in the 1691 Basel revolution.
